correctness.rationale: The bracket-preserving automorphism equation ST=aTS follows because the derived ideal is characteristic and T is invertible. It forces precisely the multiplicity-preserving scalar stabilizer and independent invertible maps along eigenspaces. For a≠1 the quotient coordinate vanishes and every spectral cycle contributes the fixedspace polynomial of a matrix product; for a=1 the translation-image membership partitions \(q^n\) translations into \(q^{n-k}\) and \(q^n-q^{n-k}\), with respective fixed dimensions \(k+1\) and \(k\). Subspace-lattice Möbius inversion proves every P_s coefficient. The polynomial sums to \(|H|q^n\prod_\lambda |\operatorname{GL}_{s_\lambda}(\mathbb F_q)|\). A direct full-matrix rank verifier checks 24 full profiles including characteristics 2 and 3 and nontrivial scalar supports; a twenty-fifth case is only a formula consistency check. Finite computations are corroboration only. No claim is made for nonsplit or nonsemisimple T.

originality.rationale: Originality is asserted solely for the complete fixedspace census on the full split semisimple almost-abelian Lie algebra with all multiplicity-decorated spectra, not for the group normal form, cycle-products, or Gaussian Möbius inversion separately. Burde–Dekimpe concerns complex existence; Avetisyan supplies the general automorphism form; Arumugam–Dietrich–Glasby covers product-action wreath statistics on the derived ideal. Their formulas do not themselves state the translation-sensitive spectrum for the whole Lie algebra. Targeted indexed-record, published-record, and full-primary-text searches reveal no dominating exact distribution. Residual risk: an unstated composite corollary of older group-action methods or equivalent archival result could cover it.

value.rationale: The natural invariant counts how many Lie algebra automorphisms fix a subspace of each possible dimension, not merely whether one fixed-point-free example exists. The closed formula spans every finite field and every multiplicity-decorated split nonzero spectrum, with a clean spectral-cycle term plus a nontrivial translation-sensitive correction. It enables exact comparison of fixedspace distributions across entire infinite families and concretely distinguishes the derived-ideal and full-Lie actions. This is a motivated complete enumeration, not an isolated small table or unsupported downstream promise.
